work_package.title: Bind Correlated Decision Receipt to Responsive Handoff Export Boundary
work_package.current_state: The Responsive handoff export boundary manifest is completed and PR #193 established a schema-backed Prompt 5 routing-to-decision-receipt correlation contract, but repository truth has no canonical binding that carries the correlated routing and receipt identity into the handoff export boundary.
work_package.target_state: A schema-backed handoff-export correlation binding and deterministic validator require each eligible Responsive handoff export boundary to reference compatible routing and decision-receipt correlation lineage while preserving Project Gate, Kernel, export-evidence, and responsive-correctness boundaries.

measurable_current_state.statement: The completed handoff export boundary and the merged routing-to-receipt correlation contract remain separate repository surfaces with no canonical cross-reference or deterministic compatibility check.
measurable_current_state.measurement: Measured by the absence of a handoff-export correlation binding, correlation-reference fields, positive and negative fixtures, dedicated diagnostics, CI wiring, and documentation or STATUS parity.

measurable_target_state.statement: Every supported handoff export boundary can reference one compatible routing-to-receipt correlation identity or fail closed on missing, divergent, duplicated, version-incompatible, authority-upgrading, or evidence-upgrading correlation state.
measurable_target_state.measurement: Accepted only when valid and negative fixtures cover missing correlation, routing or receipt identity mismatch, divergent decision lineage, outcome mismatch, duplicate receipt identity, unsupported schema version, authority substitution, and forbidden export/readiness/correctness upgrades under exact-head CI.

target_capability.statement: Responsive can validate repository-local compatibility between its handoff export boundary and the correlated Prompt 5 routing and downstream decision receipt without executing external transport or claiming a live export.
target_capability.measurement: A canonical binding contract, deterministic diagnostics, positive and negative fixtures, primary CI wiring, documentation, command-index, and STATUS parity remain mutually consistent.

work_package.expected_project_delta: The completed handoff export boundary becomes traceably compatible with the routing-to-receipt correlation surface, preventing lineage, outcome, identity, or authority ambiguity while all live export, evidence, pilot, readiness, accessibility, pixel, and responsive-correctness claims remain false.
allowed_work: Define a canonical handoff-export correlation binding that references the Prompt 5 routing identity, downstream receipt identity, shared decision lineage, route outcome, and repository-local correlation contract.

Add valid and negative fixtures for missing or divergent correlation identity, lineage mismatch, route/receipt outcome mismatch, duplicate receipt identity, version drift, authority substitution, and boundary upgrades.
Add a deterministic fail-closed validator and align primary CI, command-index, documentation, and STATUS where directly affected.
forbidden_work: Do not create submitted evidence unless explicitly authorized by the repository owner and current Issue #8 submitted-mode contracts.
Do not mutate Issue #8 or mark Issue #8 evidence as satisfied.
Do not run or authorize real pilot execution.
Do not execute Project Gate transport, reinterpret Kernel decisions, or treat human-readable receipt text as canonical decision authority.

Do not fabricate a live export or set export_json_validated, production_ready, release_ready, live_render_validated, accessibility_passed, pixel_perfect, or responsive_correctness_validated from repository checks.
Do not treat correlation completeness, CI success, merged PRs, catalog completion, or Work Package completion as domain evidence.
must_deliver: Handoff-export to routing/decision-receipt correlation binding contract and schema.
Deterministic validator with positive and negative coverage for correlation identity, decision lineage, outcome, duplicate receipt identity, version drift, authority, and boundary upgrades.
Primary validation-chain, command-index, documentation, and STATUS parity for the handoff-export correlation boundary.
must_preserve: Rolling queue remains a historical reconciled archive, not the execution driver.
Controller selection must come only from planning/EV4_AUTOMATION_WORK_PACKAGE_CATALOG.json.
Quality gates, CI, review, and evidence boundaries remain mandatory.
Technical evidence claims remain false unless real evidence gates pass.
Catalog replenishment is state-driven and must not block active Work Package execution.
Catalog replenishment must respect the single-active-mutation-PR policy.
definition_of_done: The measurable target state is met by schema-backed or validator-backed repository evidence.
The selected PR slice remains reviewable and stays under this Work Package ID.

No submitted evidence, Issue #8 mutation, pilot authorization, external transport execution, live export claim, Kernel-authority substitution, or forbidden readiness/correctness claim is produced by the Work Package.

split_rule.principle: A Work Package may be large in objective, but each PR must remain reviewable.

allowed_pr_slices.title: handoff-export correlation contract and schema
allowed_pr_slices.objective: Define the routing, receipt, decision-lineage, outcome, version, and authority references required by the Responsive handoff export boundary.
allowed_pr_slices.review_boundary: Reviewable PR slice under the same Work Package ID; no unrelated micro-objective may be introduced.

allowed_pr_slices.title: correlation fixtures, validator, and CI
allowed_pr_slices.objective: Add deterministic positive and negative handoff-export correlation coverage plus primary validation-chain wiring.
allowed_pr_slices.review_boundary: Reviewable PR slice under the same Work Package ID; no unrelated micro-objective may be introduced.

allowed_pr_slices.title: correlation documentation and STATUS parity
allowed_pr_slices.objective: Record handoff-export correlation guarantees and remaining transport, export-evidence, authority, readiness, and correctness limitations.
allowed_pr_slices.review_boundary: Reviewable PR slice under the same Work Package ID; no unrelated micro-objective may be introduced.

blocked_if: The completed handoff export manifest or the merged routing-to-receipt correlation identity cannot be determined from repository truth.
The slice would execute external Project Gate transport, reinterpret Kernel decisions, or treat receipt prose as canonical authority.

Repository checks or correlation completeness would be promoted to a live export, submitted evidence, pilot authorization, production, release, live-render, accessibility, pixel, or responsive-correctness claim.
completion_record_requirements: Record selected Work Package ID and PR slice ID in the PR body.
List files changed, validators changed, and CI commands run.
State commands not run and why.
Record whether catalog replenishment was checked and whether it was non-mutating, same-PR in-scope, or blocked by single-active-PR policy.
Record remaining risks and the next safe human action.
